decision.msg: Root cause reproduced (timeout 15, my own PIDs only, killed after): an empty heredoc or </dev/null becomes the Windows NUL device; os.isatty(NUL) is True, so Python 3.14.4 (C:/Python314, first on PATH) thinks stdin is a terminal, starts the new PyREPL and busy-loops: 2.91 CPU-s per 3 s = one full core, forever. A heredoc WITH a body, a pipe, an empty file, -c, all exit at once. Python 3.13.1 exits in 0.4 s; PYTHON_BASIC_REPL=1 makes 3.14 exit in 0.7 s. Fix alternatives: set PYTHON_BASIC_REPL=1 in the env Claude sessions get (catches every case) vs. only teaching agents not to write the idiom (misses future ones).

log.msg: Pattern census (all transcripts touched since 10-01: 10,025 files, 82,000 Bash calls): 2,184 calls pipe code into `python -`; ~96 are the empty-heredoc idiom `python3 - <<'EOF' 2>/dev/null || node -e "<the real edit>"` then EOF, i.e. python is a decoy and node does the edit. 83 Sonnet 5.5, 14 Opus 5.5, 1 Fable. It works only by accident: `python3` resolves to the Microsoft Store stub (WindowsApps), which exits 49 in 0.16 s, so the fallback runs (72 ok of 73). When the agent writes `python` instead, it gets real C:/Python314 3.14.4, which sees NUL as a terminal and spins: 20 of 23 such calls hit the 120 s timeout, each leaving a core-burning orphan. No repo instruction teaches the idiom (searched CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills, Servex roles, agents.md, agent-rules.md); minion.md line 85 only says to write a .py with the Write tool. It is a model habit, likely avoiding the heredoc-apostrophe trap minion.md warns about, instead of using Edit.

finish.outcome: The spinning pythons come from a habit agents picked up on their own: `python3 - <<'EOF' 2>/dev/null || node -e "<the real edit>"` with an empty heredoc. It works only because `python3` is the Microsoft Store stub, which fails at once. When an agent types `python`, real Python 3.14 starts, takes the NUL device for a terminal, opens its new prompt and burns a core forever: 20 of 23 such calls since 10-01 timed out, including 32556 (VS Code tab 50e085ce) and 47776 (a subagent of tab e00f55c9). Both were already gone when I checked. No instruction file teaches the idiom. Fixes: set PYTHON_BASIC_REPL=1 for every Claude session, and add a 'never python - <<' line to public/framework/ai/agents.md and Servex/agents/roles/minion.md. The 54 server.js processes are worktree dev servers that Servex/Worktrees.js remove() (line 297) never stops before `git worktree remove`; 44 are safe to kill (list in the decision line above). The tunnel 29040 is the live one, the only one: keep it. Detail in the log lines above.
